NHK Radio Japan FAQ

What frequency is NHK Radio Japan on?
In the B-26 season NHK Radio Japan is scheduled on 28 shortwave frequencies, including 6165, 6190, 9490, 9510, 9560, 9585 kHz. Best evening option for eastern North America: 9770 kHz (12 am – 1:50 am Eastern). For Europe: 9510 kHz (8 pm – 10 pm UTC+1).

What time is NHK Radio Japan on shortwave?
NHK Radio Japan is scheduled in 50 UTC time windows this season, from 00:00–00:20 UTC through 23:30–23:40 UTC. English broadcasts: 14:00–14:11 UTC. All times are UTC; subtract your UTC offset for local time.

Can I hear NHK Radio Japan in the USA?
Yes. NHK Radio Japan is beamed at North America this season on 9770 kHz; the best evening option for eastern North America is 9770 kHz (12 am – 1:50 am Eastern).

Does NHK Radio Japan broadcast in English on shortwave?
Yes. English broadcasts this season: 11920 kHz at 14:00–14:11 UTC to SE Asia.

Is NHK Radio Japan on the air right now?
As of Wednesday, November 11, 2026, 12:42 UTC, NHK Radio Japan is scheduled to be broadcasting on 6190 kHz to Far East. This is based on the published schedule at the time this page was built; check the live search for up-to-the-minute status.
